$doc: The ratchet `npm run typecheck` enforces. One entry per file that had type errors when the gate was added (Phase 5 / D57). It may SHRINK and may not GROW: a new error in any file, or one more error in a listed file, fails. So does one FEWER, which asks for the number to be lowered — a baseline that records paid debt is a baseline nobody trusts.
$added_by: Phase 5 / D57 — the gate that did not exist. Sixty-one of the 89 errors here on the day it was written were D57's own, emitted by scripts/data-contract/generate.mjs into a committed artifact since WP 5.2h. Those are fixed; these twenty-eight predate Phase 5 and belong to whoever owns each surface.

src/components/policies/StagePolicyTable.why: The policy grid's numeric cell takes a `title` prop the component does not declare, and one call passes two arguments to a one-argument function. WP 6.2's surface.

src/components/policies/policyGridUi.tsx.why: The provenance legend declares a `contract` dot the `Provenance` union does not carry, and reads `title` off a props type that has none. Same surface as the two above — the union is WP 6.2's (D91's neighbourhood).

src/components/sim/DisruptionScheduleEdi.why: `target_type` is a `"node" | "edge"` union in state and plain `string` where it is parsed. §16 · WP 6.4 records that `_targets` has this discriminator and NO validation behind it, so the type error and the missing CHECK are the same defect seen from two sides. WP 6.4's.

src/components/trust/TrustReportPanel.ts.why: The generated Supabase client types do not know `ingest_runs`, so `.from('ingest_runs')` resolves to a SelectQueryError union and every field read off it is an error. The client types are regenerated outside this repository; WP 4.4's panel, not Phase 5's.

src/components/trust/useProjectFreshness.why: `.rpc('project_freshness')` — the same stale client types as above, on the RPC side.

src/hooks/useErpConnections.tsx.why: Same cause again, and the largest instance: `project_erp_links` and `ingest_runs` are absent from the generated client types, so two casts are reported as non-overlapping and two more instantiations run away. WP 7.1's connector surface.

src/lib/policies/resolveEffective.ts.why: The resolver returns a wider provenance union than `Provenance` declares — the same missing member policyGridUi.tsx names. One fix closes both; it is WP 6.2's to make.

src/lib/policies/__tests__/dataPlaneAudi.why: `@ts-expect-error` on a JSON import that now resolves. Harmless, and deliberately left: deleting four directives across four suites is a change to four gate files for no behavioural reason, which is not a thing a documentation package should be doing.

src/lib/policies/__tests__/ingestSpecPar.why: A literal `string` widened where a `"duration" | "rate"` union is expected, in a fixture the suite builds for itself.
